تستلزموا (form X)
# تَسْتَلْزِمُوا (tastalzimū) /tas.tal.zi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# تُسْتَلْزَمُوا (tustalzamū) /tus.tal.za.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
